select br_business_type, br_account_type, br_account, br_account_desc,
       br_account_territory, br_group, br_group_desc, br_record_type, 
       br_record_value, br_record_desc, rt_transaction_id
from business_review_tab, travel_agents, rental_transactions
where br_business_type in ('PARTNER','TOUR')
    and rt_ta_nbr > 0
    and rt_ta_nbr = ta_nbr
    and ((br_record_type = 'F' and  ta_tp_nbr =  to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'G' and ta_sp_nbr =  to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'H' and ta_gp_nbr = to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'I' and TA_TRK2_PARENT_NBR = to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'J' and TA_TRK3_PARENT_NBR = to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'K' and TA_TRK11_PARENT_NBR = to_number(br_record_value)))

select br_business_type, br_account_type, br_account, br_account_desc,
       br_account_territory, br_group, br_group_desc, br_record_type, 
       br_record_value, br_record_desc, rs_transaction_id
from business_review_tab, reservation_referral_sources, reservations
where br_business_type in ('PARTNER','TOUR')
    and rs_referral_source = ref_source
    and ((br_record_type = 'V' and ref_parent = br_record_value)
      OR (br_record_type = 'X' and ref_superparent = br_record_value)
      OR (br_record_type = 'U' and ref_source = br_record_value))

select br_business_type, br_account_type, br_account, br_account_desc,
       br_account_territory, br_group, br_group_desc, br_record_type, 
       br_record_value, br_record_desc, rt_transaction_id
from business_review_tab, cdpids, contracts, rental_transactions
where br_business_type in ('PARTNER','TOUR')
    and cd_cdpid = rt_ckin_cdpid
    and cn_contract_number =  cd_cn_contract_number
    and cn_contract_number_sub = cd_cn_contract_number_sub 
    and ((br_record_type = 'B' and cd_cn_contract_number = to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'C' and cn_cr_parent_nbr = to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'D' and cn_cg_parent_nbr = to_number(br_record_value)))

select br_business_type, br_account_type, br_account, br_account_desc,
       br_account_territory, br_group, br_group_desc, br_record_type, 
       br_record_value, br_record_desc, rt_transaction_id
from business_review_tab, cdpids, travel_agents, rental_transactions
where cd_cdpid = rt_ckin_cdpid
    and rt_ta_nbr = ta_nbr
    and br_business_type = 'TRAVEL'
    and ((br_account_type = 'E' and to_number(br_account) = ta_nbr)
       OR (br_account_type = 'F' and to_number(br_account) = ta_tp_nbr)
       OR (br_account_type = 'G' and to_number(br_account) = ta_sp_nbr)
       OR (br_account_type = 'H' and to_number(br_account) = ta_gp_nbr)
       OR (br_account_type = 'I' and to_number(br_account) = TA_TRK2_PARENT_NBR)
       OR (br_account_type = 'J' and to_number(br_account) = TA_TRK3_PARENT_NBR)
       OR (br_account_type = 'K' and to_number(br_account) = TA_TRK11_PARENT_NBR))
    and ((br_record_type = 'A' and cd_cdpid = to_number(br_record_value))
      OR (br_record_type = 'B' and cd_cn_contract_number = to_number(br_record_value)))

select br_business_type, br_account_type, br_account, br_account_desc,
       br_account_territory, br_group, br_group_desc, br_record_type, 
       br_record_value, br_record_desc, rt_transaction_id
from business_review_tab, tours, rental_transactions
where br_business_type in ('PARTNER','TOUR')
    and rt_it_number is not null
    and rt_it_number = tr_it_number
    and ((br_record_type = 'N' and tr_it_parent = br_record_value)
      OR (br_record_type = 'O' and tr_it_superparent = br_record_value))

select br_business_type, br_account_type, br_account, br_account_desc,
       br_account_territory, br_group, br_group_desc, br_record_type, 
       br_record_value, br_record_desc, rt_transaction_id
from business_review_tab, rental_transactions, geographies
where br_business_type in ('PARTNER','TOUR')
    and rt_ckot_loc_id = ge_loc_id
    and ge_fbo_loc_flag = 'Y'
    and br_record_type = 'Z' and substr(ge_company_name,1,20) = br_record_value

select br_business_type, br_account_type, br_account, br_account_desc,
       br_account_territory, br_group, br_group_desc, br_record_type,

from business_review_tab, conventions, rental_transactions
where br_business_type in ('PARTNER','TOUR')
